counterfactual_missing_items: HMB45 and Melan A were negative
CD117, DOG1, cytokeratin, CD34, smooth muscle actin, desmin, chromogranin, and CD56 were all negative
decisive_items: an exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
uniform epithelioid and spindle cells arranged in nested and fascicular patterns, with variable eosinophilic or clear cytoplasm
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10
response.rationale: C1 is the most complete fit: small-bowel/ileal location plus nested epithelioid/spindle clear-cell morphology and diffuse S100/SOX10 positivity support clear cell sarcoma of the small intestine. R3 MPNST shares S100/SOX10 but lacks the characteristic nested clear-cell epithelioid pattern and small-bowel site. R1 GIST is excluded by CD117/DOG1 negativity. R2 is the same entity without the site-specific anatomy and is therefore subsumed by C1.

rejected.why: GIST is contradicted by negative CD117 and DOG1, despite overlapping histologic features.
Subsumed by C1 as a correlated restatement; it lacks the small-intestinal site-specific raw support.
